notes.title: Border of her Heart will have a sequel!
notes.content:
[h1]I am pleased to tell Border of her Heart fans that the game will have a sequel[/h1]

The game will take place after events of the first game, however playing the first game won't be necessary as location and the people involved are all different. Some events you'll appreciate a bit more though, if you know the context to them, such as the plague.

Wishlist it today, as we'll have a small playable demo later this month!!

notes.title: FULL RELEASE! Version 1.0

[b]Armor[/b]

[list][*]Uncommon armors now drop with each Earth Monster 
[*]New uncommon armor, Knight Shield[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]

[*]Erotic Manusaurus can perform Money Shots better
[*]Erotic Manusaurus can now seduce you
[*]Chain Coiff base is only 7 defense (was 8)
[*]Bad Mr. Frosty base hp is now 20000 (was 15500)
[*]Bad Mr. Frosty base attack is now 85 (was 70)
[*]Bad Mr. Frosty base defense is now 36 (was 30)
[*]Bad Mr. Frosty now enjoys same sort of 30% barrier that his hat would grant player
[*]Regular attacks now only deal damage based on attack power (was 2 times attack power), projectile attacks such as bows and guns and special weapons like Doombringer are unaffected
[*]Mad people at Hospital have max level of 10
[*]Lunar Flare now deals 5% of max HP of enemy as damage and no bonus damage (was 7% + 300 hp) 
[*]Summon Ignis now costs 200 MP (was 160) 
[*]Summon Lady of Ice now costs 200 MP (was 185)
[*]You need to be level 8 to learn Summon Ignis 
[*]You need to be level 9 to learn Summon Lady of Ice
[*]Flame Barrage now requires you to be lvl 6 to learn it (was 11)
[*]Freeze Ray now requires you to be lvl 7 to learn it (was 12)
[*]Blind now requires you to be level 10 to learn it (was 14)
[*]Confusion now requires you to be level 12 to learn it (was 24)
[*]Water Spirits are now weak to Thunder
[*]Water Spirits now absorb Water
[*]Interacting with the fountain at Little Fire displayed you as male regardless of gender chosen, this has been fixed
[*]Cain Attack is 50 (was 40)
[*]Cain Wisdom is 55 (was 45)
[*]Chon Max HP is now 10000 (was 6000)
[*]Chon Defense is 55 (was 50)[/list]

[b]Battle system[/b]

[list][*]Completely overhauled battle system [/list]

[b]Blackjack[/b]

[list][*]You can now play Blackjack at the Casino[/list]

[b]Boulderscar[/b]

[list][*]Added random houses for immersion[/list]

[b]Bugfix[/b]

[list][*]Friendship sending you to wrong location on spawn has been fixed
[*]Calling friendship again when driving friendship is no longer possible
[*]You could walk on flags at your castle at Earth, this has been fixed
[*]You could walk on the telporter poles in the teleport room of your castle, this has been fixed
[*]Becky didn't become part of Friendship when playing as male and talking to her, this has been fixed
[*]After certain time, Slayer Sword didn't work as intended, this has been fixed
[*]Spheres had a problem that prevented them from working correctly, this has been fixed
[*]Susan Cole was able to Detoriate and Evolution at the same time, this has been fixed
[*]If you didn't have the journal already and then agreed to help him and later returned to him again, Gustav didn't advance his stage in a quest properly making him unrecruitable to friendship, this has been fixed
[*]Wrong map marker made Tree Huggers & Co always visible even before you found it, this has been fixed
[*]Ordering Water at Cluber Eternity was said to be free but then you were charged anyway, this has been fixed
[*]Playing as a female didn't clear "Fun after work" mainquest, this has been fixed
[*]Playing as a female didn't clear "Those dang bandits" sidequest, this has been fixed
[*]Passability problem in Casino Basement has been fixed
[*]Passability problem in Dudecave has been fixed
[*]Passability problem in Jessica's Castle has been fixed
[*]You could use "Staff Speciality" even though it was a passive, this has been fixed
[*]You could use "Magic Aura" even though it was a passive, this has been fixed
[*]Meditation didn't give you TP, this has been fixed[/list]

[b]Cache[/b]

[list][*]Improved cache for less memory usage[/list]

[b]Description[/b]

[list][*]Added better description that turning Behemoth increases all stats including Wisdom of Rosa[/list]

[b]Dragonbones[/b]

[list][*]Dragonbones integrated monsters[/list]

[b]Export Character[/b]

[list][*]If you beat the game and receive a good ending, you'll be asked if you want to export the save data. This will be used to transfer important choices that you've made in this game, to be read in a potential sequel.[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]

[list][*]Completely redesigned the way battles work
[*]Reworked accuracy for less misses
[*]Leveling up now heals you and restores your mana
[*]You'll always succeed at escaping
[*]Message default speed is now 9
[*]Disabled all mouse inputs due to popular demand
[*]Skills no longer move you in rows
[*]Spheres now deal their magical damage as an added elemental damage[/list]

[b]Graphics[/b]

[list][*]Susan Cole has a new sprite
[*]Dad has a new sprite
[*]Dad has new emote bust
[*]Sanefang has emote bust
[*]Row formation now has character faces instead of sprites
[*]Dragonbones animated sprite for Ice Titan
[*]Improved sprite for Ice Titan

[*]Improved animed sprite for Stamalia
[*]Yeti is now animated in battles
[*]Succubus is now animated in battle

[b]Label[/b]

[list][*]Barklar is labeled on map
[*]Fishing Village is labeled on map[/list]

[b]Loading[/b]

[list][*]Drastically reduced loading screens[/list]

[b]Loot[/b]

[list][*]Added Rare quality weighted weapon drops with 25% chance of rare drops
[*]Another Dimension monsters drop uncommon quality weapons
[*]Another Dimension monsters drop uncommon quality armor
[*]Earth monsters now drop Rare quality weapons
[*]Alpha 42 monsters now drop Rare quality weapons
[*]Ring of Doubling is considered rare item (was uncommon)[/list]

[b]Lore[/b]

[list][*]Renamed Stella into Stamalia to keep in line with the lore books[/list]

[b]Minigame[/b]

[list][*]You can play BlackJack at Casino[/list]

[b]Mining[/b]

[list][*]Added two new Shadow Obsidian mining spots to Water Cave[/list]

[b]Optimization[/b]

[list][*]Optimizations across the engine[/list]

[b]Size[/b]

[list][*]Compressed some graphical elements to help improve load times[/list]

[*]New rare sword Katana
